goal: Jobs + Applications full-stack feature: admin job CRUD in AdminD (Addjobs wired to the API), public Career list/detail rendered from real data, public Apply with base64 resume, and an admin Applications report with status workflow (NEW/REVIEWED/ACCEPTED/REJECTED).
stack: Spring Boot 3.3.4 / Java 17 / Spring Data JPA (H2 dev, Neon PostgreSQL prod) + React 19 / Vite / Tailwind / react-router-dom 7. Auth: existing JwtAuthFilter — /api/admin/** hasRole(ADMIN), /api/public/** permitAll (SecurityConfig already covers both; NO security changes). Follow the proven Member Management pattern (entity/repository/dto/service/controller + ApiResponse envelope).
flow: Admin: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/jobs (JobDto), GET /api/admin/applications, GET /api/admin/applications/{id}, PATCH /api/admin/applications/{id}/status {status}, DELETE /api/admin/applications/{id}. Public: GET /api/public/jobs, GET /api/public/jobs/{id}, POST /api/public/jobs/{id}/apply (JobApplicationDto {jobId,fullName,email,phone,linkedinUrl,coverLetter,resumeName,resumeData,resumeContentType} -> status NEW). Job detail route /career-detail/:id (state fallback); apply route /apply-now?job=<id>. Resume = base64 TEXT + filename + content type in DB; admin view opens it as a data URI. Deleting a job that has applications fails with ConflictException (no cascade).
constraints: Do NOT import org.springframework.security.web.filter.* or org.springframework.security.web.cors.* (corrupted jar on this machine) — new code needs none; leave SecurityConfig untouched.
Always `mvn clean` before test/run (stale target/ poisons builds with Unresolved compilation problems); Lombok/JDK fixes live in pom.xml — do not change it.
Wrap every endpoint in ApiResponse {success,message,data}; throw ApiException subclasses (NotFoundException/BadRequestException/ConflictException) from services; @Transactional on writes.

Field names are part of the API contract (job: title/department/location/type/salary/description/requirements/benefits; application: jobId/fullName/email/phone/linkedinUrl/coverLetter/resumeName/resumeData/resumeContentType/status) — do not rename.
Job multi-line fields are line-oriented: JobDto.description line 1 = Job Overview paragraph, lines 2+ = Key Responsibilities bullets; requirements/benefits lines = bullet lists on Careerdetail.
Status is a String column limited to NEW/REVIEWED/ACCEPTED/REJECTED; reject anything else with BadRequestException.
Resume: frontend caps file at ~2MB; backend rejects resumeData > ~5M chars with BadRequestException (TEXT column, like member photos).

AdminD: jobs and applications are ADMIN-only — add '/admin/applications' to the adminOnly list and a new sidebar item (Management section); Applications.jsx is a single list+detail page (no extra route).
Deleting a job that has applications must fail with ConflictException — do not cascade-delete applications.

backend.name: backend-jobs
backend.task: Job entity (TEXT columns for description/requirements/benefits, @PrePersist/@PreUpdate timestamps like Member) + JobRepository + JobDto (combined, @NotBlank title/department/location/type) + JobService (CRUD, NotFoundException; delete throws ConflictException when applications exist) + JobController /api/admin/jobs + PublicJobController GET /api/public/jobs and /{id} (full safe fields).

backend.name: backend-applications
backend.task: JobApplication entity (@ManyToOne fetch=LAZY Job, status default NEW) + JobApplicationRepository (@EntityGraph job, ordered by createdAt desc) + JobApplicationDto (request jobId, response adds id/jobTitle/status/createdAt) + JobApplicationService (apply->NEW, list w/ jobTitle, validated updateStatus, delete, resumeData size guard) + AdminApplicationController /api/admin/applications + PublicApplyController POST /api/public/jobs/{id}/apply. Depends on backend-jobs Job/JobRepository — author those files first, then this slice.

frontend.name: frontend-api
frontend.task: Rework src/api/api.js: jobAPI -> /admin/jobs CRUD (token auto-attached by request helper), applicationAPI -> /admin/applications (getAll/getById/updateStatus PATCH/DELETE) + applyJob(jobId, payload), publicAPI.getJobs/getJobById under /public/jobs. Leave authAPI/memberAPI/productAPI untouched.
